title: The engine-boundary path
description: A small Lua expression can cross several layers before it returns to Lua.

nodes.title: LuaJIT VM / JIT
nodes.detail: Optimizes Lua around the call when it can.

nodes.title: Binding dispatch
nodes.detail: Resolves and invokes the exposed API.

nodes.title: Argument conversion
nodes.detail: Converts Lua values for the native call.

nodes.title: Engine subsystem
nodes.detail: World, physics, records, rendering, or another subsystem does the work.

nodes.title: Return-value conversion
nodes.detail: The result crosses back through the binding layer.

nodes.title: Userdata / value allocation
nodes.detail: The result may construct a temporary native-backed value.

nodes.title: Lua code again
nodes.detail: Only now can the script consume the result.
